decisions.evidence: Overall, the structure is moderately polar, aromatic, and heteroatom-rich, with a weak basic center and no hydroxyl donor; these combined features make it less convincingly a CYP3A4 substrate, so the prediction is that it is not a substrate to CYP3A4.

Because the non-substrate comparisons are at least as persuasive as the substrate ones, and because several of the substrate neighbors still end up closer to the non-substrate side on the full set of observed features, the overall prediction is that the molecule is not a substrate to CYP3A4.
